about_the_game:
Play as a worm working remotely as a Financial Analyst in Worming from Home, a 3D third-person comedy simulation game where you have to work your menial desk job without exposing your worm identity to your boss. By throwing your worm weight around, smashing your head on keyboard keys, and pretending to be a real human on a one-on-one video call with your boss, you will conquer the daily toil of salaried employment and reach the promotion that you've always dreamed of! Bring your hard earned income to the online shop to buy new upgrades and tools to make worm life just a little bit easier, or blow all of your money on a worm-sized fedora!

Embody the Worm

Everyone has always secretly wondered what it must feel like to live as a dexterous, smooth, agile invertebrate. Well now you can find out! With a highly advanced ragdoll worm system and physics that will make you say "wow, I didn't think a worm could throw that far", your yearning for worm immersion will finally be satisfied. Feel your rubbery body flip and soar through the air, and use your impressive flexibility to slam your head back down into the ground. It's a beautiful thing, trust me.

Unique Tasks

What does a remote-working Financial Analyst do, you ask? When you're a worm, it's simple. You respond to messages that your boss sends with basic, one word answers. You type random numbers into a spreadsheet to make it look like the company is doing very well. You hold pictures of real humans in front of your webcam and hope that your boss doesn't see a little bit of your worm body slithering behind it. When you're off work, spend your relaxing evenings exploring, taking a load off, or being a good little employee and preparing for the next work day. There's so many wonders to find on the desk when you're that small, so go see what you can find. And if you need something a bit more capitalist, get on that computer and do some shopping! 

Online Shopping

All of that hard earned money has to go somewhere, and what's better than a little retail therapy. Buy upgrades and tools to make your workdays go a bit smoother, like worm-sized weights or a brand new worm-gonomic mouse! Or, if working more efficiently and effectively isn't your style, there's plenty of "useful" cosmetics to buy. Maybe you need a new succulent to sit there and look pretty on your desk. Come to think of it, you could use a little bit of a makeover, so how's about a stylish worm-sized fedora!

name: Worming from Home
short_description: You may be a worm, but that doesn't have to stop you from becoming the world's greatest Financial Analyst! Slam your head on keyboard keys, impersonate a human, and finish the week without being found out as a worm to work your way up to the ultimate corporate achievement: a promotion!
